claims.candidate_claim: Conditional on a stable case-specific observation process, local reproduction may predict persistence better than national manpower or violence totals alone.
minimum_promotion_evidence: frozen holdout comparison against manpower-only and violence-only competitors

claims.candidate_claim: Exposure/contact, initiation or recruitment, and local sustainment are conjunctive prerequisites for reproduction.
minimum_promotion_evidence: historical activation genealogy or an equivalent identified measurement
at least two eligible cases showing the predicted negative constraint

claims.candidate_claim: Adjacency can shape renewal and concentration, but adjacency alone is not evidence of reproduction.
minimum_promotion_evidence: historical nonzero adjacent activation in at least two eligible cases

claims.candidate_claim: Persistent presence matters through memory and control, not static occupancy alone.
minimum_promotion_evidence: control and expectation outcomes beyond memory stock
independent presence/operator validation in at least two eligible cases

claims.candidate_claim: Counterinsurgency succeeds when it interrupts local reproduction with persistent credible security, information, governance, and changed expectations.
minimum_promotion_evidence: joint control, harm, capacity, regeneration, dependence, and recurrence outcomes
holdout and reduced-model comparisons in at least two eligible cases

claims.candidate_claim: Insurgent movement is a portfolio of frontier expansion, foothold consolidation, stronghold retention, and uncertainty-driven exploration constrained by route risk and sanctuary access.
minimum_promotion_evidence: frozen holdout comparison against simpler movement rules
evidence that movement changes local reproduction rather than only trajectories

rule: This matrix can lag only toward weaker language. It must never promote a claim from synthetic, descriptive, legacy, or ineligible case evidence into historical or general support.
